branch_determinicity_may_assert: conditioned branch membership and response distribution
predictor/splitter association within the governed universe and risk set
support missingness weights uncertainty and exact stop state
same-respondent co-signature/cotravel within an exact conditioned branch
multimodality supported minority structure and branch-shape descriptors where lawfully measurable
branch_determinicity_may_not_assert: causal origin of an actor disposition
biography memory knowledge relationship or developmental history
membership of a generated actor in an empirical branch without separate comparator/binding authority

relation_channel_inference.rule: Exact branch statistics may generate a provenance-bearing candidate relation modifier but structural/causal labels become authoritative only under explicit semantic transformation and structural-admission authority.

separate_authority_gates: response semantic and routing/risk-set authority before empirical interpretation
generated-actor fact to empirical-conditioner comparator/binding authority
V3 developmental realization authority for history memory belief and response

examples_requiring_separate_authority: class-legibility as structural meaning rather than measured response-category salience

historical_overreach_findings.rule: At most it can denote an uncertainty-bearing empirical possibility field; actor realization remains V3-owned.
Structural channels/pressure are subsurface priors and cannot directly set voice belief personality consciousness or biography.

claim_ceiling: No positive positioned-subject inference model is invented.
No structural channel label is promoted merely because it appeared in an originary proposal.
No empirical association is upgraded to causal explanation.
